summary: Wellgistics Health, Inc. filed an 8-K/A to amend a prior 8-K, correcting the report date and restating Item 1.01 regarding an Amended Settlement Agreement with Silverback Capital Corporation. The amendment clarifies the entry into the agreement constitutes a material definitive agreement. No financial terms, board recommendation, or advisors are disclosed. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. Instead, it corrects a routine contractual disclosure. There is no special situation or event-driven catalyst, and the item is purely administrative. No deal terms are applicable.
